desc: The Aristaeus is the flagship 300 Blackout Zeus Arms model. These pistols come fully equipped surpressor ready and will cycle Subsonic and Super Sonic ammunition with or without a surpressor. Featuring an adjustable gas block, Billet 7075 Lower and Upper Receivers, 3.5LB Straight Drop In Trigger, Ambidextrous Safety and Mag Release, lightweight endplate with QD attachment, upgraded flat wire buffer spring, Phase 5 B.A.D. Lever, SBA3 brace and more!
